name: Takeuchi Yuka
source:
Birthplace / Origin: Tokyo metropolitan area.
Occupation: 3rd-year (senior) at city academy "T", part-time waitress (Hanna Miller's).
Likes / Loves: Fruits, video games.

A refreshing "sports girl" with a strong sense of justice. Yuka is liked both by her classmates and underclassmen. She uses "Boku" (a Japanese pronoun) when referring to herself. Yuka has a 4-dan full contact karate skills and a black belt. She won a V.G. tournament in the past.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=7240]Getchu[/url].]
